{{Top|leg}}
The '''Inner River District''' was a district on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teyr/Legends|Teyr]]. [[Sodonna]] was the gateway to go here. The Inner River District had docks and jobs available, until [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] transports took the commerce away from the [[Noga River]], where the district was located. The docks were gone after this by [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]].
